# Alpine Base & Edge

> > Boulder's premier ski shop specializing in expert tuning, boot fitting, rentals, and race gear—founded by U.S. Ski Team racer Peter Boyer, now led by Kris and Danielle Steigerwald.

Alpine Base & Edge serves Boulder and Front Range skiers with professional services including same-day tuning, Wintersteiger equipment, Phantom Glide treatments, and seasonal rentals for Eldora, Winter Park, and beyond. The shop also offers summer recreation with Boulder Creek tubing, kayak, and SUP rentals.

## Key Topics

- ski tuning and edge sharpening
- boot fitting and custom adjustments
- ski rentals (daily and seasonal)
- race gear and athlete sponsorship
- binding mounting and adjustment
- base repair and core shot repair
- ski waxing and Phantom Glide
- Eldora and Colorado ski resorts
- Wintersteiger tuning equipment
- Boulder Creek summer rentals
- Peter Boyer (founder, U.S. Ski Team)
- Kris and Danielle Steigerwald (owners)
- same-day service
- race tuning for World Cup standards
